title: Rate-limit fallback to StateChange: client requirement missing
description: §7 says servers MAY fall back to delivering a plain StateChange when rate limits are exceeded. Clients must not break when they receive a StateChange instead of a ChatMessagePush, but the spec has no corresponding client requirement stating this. The client behavior should be normatively specified in the delivery or client-behavior section.
close_reason: Added client MUST sentence: handle StateChange fallback identically to an unaugmented StateChange
